node.title: PROVED lever (M2/M2'): the p = -1 mod n two-valuedness criterion
node.statement: At rows with p = -1 mod n (the q = p^2 extension rows): R' underlies a trade iff x^{h-1}/L_R'(x) is two-valued +-gamma and balanced on the support (exhaustive at (16,4,31^2); the p = -1 condition shown NECESSARY at 7^2). A genuinely new per-row criterion for the extension-field branch; potential mid/large-h tool at those rows.
